title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
summary: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise spatial grounding remains difficult. Visual generative models offer rich priors over plausible arrangements, yet their outputs require geometric reasoning to become physically valid 3D scenes. We introduce SceneBloom, an agentic framework that combines visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D compilation. A hierarchical sampler uses diffusion priors to generate furniture arrangements within functional zones. A compiler then uses relations extracted from each proposal to guide geometric fitting and local pose correction. Across five room types, SceneBloom attains the highest visual quality and physical stability among the compared methods and is the only method with no detected mesh collisions and out-of-bounds objects. Its layouts are also closer to the distribution of real rooms than those of all compared baselines. Object navigation policies trained in these realistic scenes achieve a higher success rate in held-out real scans than those trained on an equal number of real training scans. Code is available at https://github.com/Tinaliu0123/scenebloom.

AI.tldr: 结合扩散先验和几何编译生成物理有效且逼真的3D室内场景，从而提升对象导航策略的训练效果。
AI.motivation: 训练具身智能体需要真实、多样的室内环境。语言引导方法缺乏精确的空间定位，而视觉生成模型的输出缺乏几何有效性。
AI.method: 提出SceneBloom框架，使用带有扩散先验的分层采样器在功能区内生成布局，随后通过编译器利用提取的关系进行几何拟合和局部姿态校正。
AI.result: 在五种房间类型中，SceneBloom在视觉质量和物理稳定性方面表现最佳，无网格碰撞和越界物体，且更接近真实房间分布。在这些场景中训练的导航策略在保留的真实扫描中的成功率高于在等量真实扫描中训练的策略。
AI.conclusion: SceneBloom成功生成了逼真且物理有效的3D场景，有利于对象导航策略的训练，弥合了生成模型与几何推理之间的差距。

title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
summary: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RynnUnify，一个结合具身理解与长程视觉规划的16B统一具身模型，并通过扩展实现机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决具身理解与视觉规划割裂的问题，将物理世界的理解与预测能力转化为实际的机器人控制，迈向统一的具身大脑。
AI.method: 通过交错视频-语言推理结合具身理解与视觉规划；利用强化学习开发智能体扩展以预测并推理未观测状态；开发世界-动作扩展将能力转化为机器人控制。同时引入Rynn-VP和Rynn-GEU评测基准。
AI.result: RynnUnify在具身理解平均分上领先同类模型，Rynn-VP得分较Cosmos 3 Nano提升9.75分；智能体扩展使Rynn-GEU均分较直接推理提升6.0分；世界-动作扩展在RoboCasa365任务上成功率达51.5%，在真实机器人任务上平均成功率达46.7%。
AI.conclusion: RynnUnify为具身理解、视觉规划与机器人控制建立了共享基础，向统一具身大脑迈出了重要一步。

title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
summary: Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. Their error rate is rarely measured: the stored labels were written by the system itself. We present Foyer, a self-hosted personal inbox agent in daily use, and a measurement protocol (stratified sampling, frozen snapshots, thread-grouped splits, pre-registered hypotheses, human labels in the agent's review loop) that yields ground truth before any training. On 739 real Italian/English emails labelled by the owner (231 unbiased, 500 adversarially sampled), we compare nine systems under thread-grouped cross-validation: the production keyword rules, a TF-IDF + logistic-regression baseline, local typed decision models (Tev1, Nimble), a hosted decision model (Nimble v4-max), and hosted generative LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma 4 26B/31B). Four results. The production rules score 28% on message type against a 58% majority class: the field shown most prominently carried no information. With ~200 labels, logistic regression has the highest accuracy on every field (type 0.79, urgency 0.74, needs-reply 0.83, is-noise 0.90), though it never predicts the two rarest classes and is statistically tied with Gemma 4 on type; few-shot prompting does not close the gap. The sender's relationship (client, supplier, service) is recovered from other emails of the same contact with 98.6% accuracy where the contact has been seen, and is not inferable from a single message by any model: it belongs in the contact graph, not the prompt. Finally, accuracy is not the product metric: composed into actions, the most accurate system most often ignores emails needing action (18% vs 4% for the best LLM); a cost-chosen threshold on its noise probability halves that rate and makes it the cheapest system.
comment: 8 pages, 7 tables. Single-user case study. Code and protocol: https://gitlab.com/federicolucca/foyer-measure . The emails are private and not released

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Foyer的自托管个人邮件代理及其测量协议，发现简单的逻辑回归在准确率上优于复杂模型，但准确率并非最优的产品评估指标。
AI.motivation: 个人邮件代理的系统错误率很少被测量，因为存储的标签由系统自身生成，缺乏真实标签来验证代理决策的准确性。
AI.method: 提出了自托管代理Foyer及一套测量协议（分层抽样、快照冻结、线程分组拆分、预注册假设、人类标签），并在739封真实邮件上通过线程分组交叉验证比较了9种系统（从关键词规则到生成式LLM）。
AI.result: 逻辑回归在仅约200个标签时各项准确率最高（类型0.79等），优于生产规则和LLM；发件人关系需从联系人图谱恢复而非单封邮件推断；最准确的系统在执行动作时最易忽略需操作的邮件（18%），而基于成本调整阈值可将其降至4%并成为最廉价系统。
AI.conclusion: 准确率并非邮件代理的最终产品指标；简单的统计模型在低数据量下比大型语言模型更具竞争力；结构化信息应放入图结构而非提示词中；优化操作成本而非单纯准确率能带来更优的系统设计。

title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
summary: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent's position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen's paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM代理在意见模拟中对互补主张的概率报告之和不为1，揭示了模拟概率在语义重述下缺乏一致性。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决LLM代理意见模拟中概率报告是否真正反映代理信念的问题，验证将主张改写为互补形式后，概率报告是否满足逻辑一致性（p与1-p之和为1）。
AI.method: 通过将主张改写为互补形式并要求模型报告概率，测试Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B和Gemma-3-4B在多种数据集和模拟状态下的表现，分析互补报告之和是否为1，并评估反馈循环、群体分歧及平均配对答案对一致性的影响。
AI.result: 模型对互补主张的概率报告之和普遍大于1，未能通过一致性测试；该差异在多次采样、不同同伴组规模和报告强度下持续存在；在模拟反馈中，从互补状态开始的群体未能保持镜像对称；平均配对答案虽能恢复一致性并降低Brier损失，但仅在部分模型中优于原始表述。
AI.conclusion: 在将LLM模拟的概率解读为代理信念前，需进行针对语义重述一致性测试，因为当前模型在互补重写下的逻辑一致性存在缺陷。

title: J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
summary: Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender's reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. Intuitively, H provides inputs for the Receiver to reason from, while J offers additional guidance within its computation. The Receiver reconstructs these cues using its own dictionary and injects them into intermediate layers during prefill, enabling communication without sharing key-value caches or requiring identical model widths. In Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-4B communication, J-Comm achieves the highest mean score across seven benchmarks, including 94.80% on MATH500, 54.55% on GPQA-Diamond, 73.33% on AIME2024+2025, and 62.93% success on ALFWorld. Compared with TextMAS, it improves performance by 1.29-8.59 percentage points and reduces generated text tokens by 19.2-74.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出J-Comm框架，通过几何一致性潜在推理（GEAR）和H+J通信接口实现模型间的高效潜在通信，在多个基准测试上取得最优性能同时大幅减少生成token数。
AI.motivation: 潜在通信需要同时具备有效的连续推理过程和外部模型可利用中间计算结果的接口，现有方法在跨模型通信效率与兼容性方面存在不足。
AI.method: J-Comm包含两个核心组件：(1) GEAR——一种无需训练的方法，通过在嵌入空间中单调优化候选token间的几何共识来重新加权token候选；(2) H+J通信接口——H通道提供来自反馈分布的连续输入供接收模型推理，J通道以词汇索引的Jacobian透镜坐标传递中间状态线索，接收模型用自身字典重建这些线索并在预填充阶段注入中间层，无需共享键值缓存或要求模型宽度一致。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B到Qwen3-4B通信中，J-Comm在七个基准测试上取得最高平均分，包括MATH500 94.80%、GPQA-Diamond 54.55%、AIME2024+2025 73.33%、ALFWorld 62.93%。与TextMAS相比，性能提升1.29-8.59个百分点，生成文本token减少19.2-74.8%。
AI.conclusion: J-Comm框架通过无需训练的几何一致性重加权与双通道H+J通信接口，实现了不同宽度模型间的高效潜在通信，在性能与效率上均显著优于现有方法。

title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
summary: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopKLoRA，一种设计上可解释的LoRA变体，能生成稀疏电路以定位并手术式消除模型后门。
AI.motivation: 在来源不明的含毒数据上微调会植入难以定位和清除的后门，且现有参数高效微调方法缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出TopKLoRA，一种可解释的LoRA变体，每个token仅激活k个最大适配器潜在变量，且仅通过下游损失训练；并结合梯度路由构建具有局部化电路的模型生物。
AI.result: 在多个模型的睡眠代理后门案例中，成功识别并消除了后门必需且充分的电路；生成的稀疏电路比密集LoRA基线小一个数量级，且在不牺牲指令遵循性能的情况下实现了恶意能力的手术式消除。
AI.conclusion: 本研究是迈向可解释性设计架构的重要一步，该架构在不牺牲性能的前提下提供了可靠的分析单元。

title: Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
summary: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and they need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on, not stakeholder documentation. A seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline recovered this logic, processing 241 repositories across 18 services into thousands of artifacts describing scope, journeys, rules and acceptance criteria. Recovery does not confer usability. Entities like offer, eligibility, and activation recur across services under a shared vocabulary, related in name but operationally distinct, so one end-to-end journey implicates over a thousand near-identical rules that must not be conflated. Flat vector retrieval fails, returning an identical rule from the wrong service at high similarity with no signal of error. Content-level ontology, the traditional remedy, did not exist, and relating every occurrence of recurring entities would have cost more than the engagement and not survived a release cycle. We place the ontology at the artifact level. In this machine-generated corpus, each artifact retains its producer, component, service, domain and type, provenance that disambiguates before content is read. We present a knowledge layer that organizes before retrieving: a self-describing catalog, a sparse metadata registry, and a navigation hypergraph defined over artifacts rather than extracted entities. Queries resolve to artifact identifiers that constrain vector search, so the competing rule from another service is absent rather than outranked, making disambiguation structural, not statistical. Built in under a week and admitting new services by convention, the layer serves SDLC agents, developers, quality engineers and analysts. It supported root-cause analysis and resolution of 100+ production defects with developer verification and attributed 35 release regression failures to specific rules and services.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种工件级别的知识层架构，通过结构化消歧解决代理AI在软件开发生命周期中检索行为逻辑时跨服务混淆规则的问题。
AI.motivation: 代理AI在检索系统行为逻辑时，现有的平面向量检索在处理跨服务重复但操作不同的实体规则时容易混淆且无错误信号，而传统的实体级本体成本过高且难以在发布周期内存活。
AI.method: 提出在工件级别而非内容实体级别放置本体的知识层。该层包含自描述目录、稀疏元数据注册表和导航超图，利用工件的溯源信息约束向量搜索，将消歧过程结构化而非统计化。
AI.result: 该系统在一周内构建完成并支持通过约定接入新服务。实际应用中支持了100多个生产缺陷的根本原因分析与解决，并将35个发布回归故障精确归因于特定规则和服务。
AI.conclusion: 工件级别的本体架构能有效克服平面向量检索的局限性，实现跨服务行为逻辑的结构化消歧，并在实际软件开发生命周期和缺陷解决中展现出显著应用价值。

title: OpenStripe supports open-set identification and spatial stripe profiling in wild Amur tigers
summary: Non-invasive camera-trap monitoring of endangered wildlife requires open-set individual identification---grouping field images into identities without predefined classes or a known population size---yet pose deformation and cluttered backgrounds complicate image comparison. Here, we present OpenStripe, a multi-agent framework that reconstructs canonical two-dimensional (2D) tiger torso patterns and encodes four interpretable local stripe structures: breakpoints, bifurcations, irregular structures, and round structures. We evaluated OpenStripe on 100 camera-trap records from 28 wild Amur tigers (Panthera tigris altaica), representing nearly one-third of the documented population in the Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park. Combining all four complementary structures enabled automatic identity grouping with 0.90 matched accuracy and a 0.85 adjusted Rand index (ARI), outperforming 49 baseline configurations under the same backend (up to 0.43 accuracy and 0.14 ARI). In addition, results from OpenStripe indicate that stripe similarity in Amur tigers declines with geographic distance and suggest that traits such as fractal dimension and inter-stripe spacing are associated with geographic proximity. OpenStripe thus provides an interpretable representation that connects automated individual grouping with spatial phenotypic profiling in wild populations.
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and nonspatial data: https://github.com/Yichun-Peng/OpenStripe

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OpenStripe多智能体框架，通过重建老虎躯干斑纹模式并提取可解释的局部条纹结构，实现了野生动物的开放式个体识别与空间表型分析。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式相机陷阱监测濒危野生动物需要进行开放式个体识别，但在没有预定义类别和已知种群规模的情况下，姿态变形和背景杂乱使得图像比对十分复杂。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架OpenStripe，重建标准的2D老虎躯干斑纹模式，并编码四种可解释的局部条纹结构（断点、分叉、不规则结构和圆形结构）。
AI.result: 在28只野生东北虎的100条相机陷阱记录上测试，该框架实现了0.90的匹配准确率和0.85的调整兰德指数，显著优于49种基线配置；同时发现条纹相似性随地理距离下降，且部分条纹特征与地理邻近性相关。
AI.conclusion: OpenStripe提供了一种可解释的表征方法，成功将野生种群的自动化个体分组与空间表型特征分析相结合。

title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
summary: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HarnessMM方法，通过受保护的决策重用和递归自我改进来减少智能体框架中的重复推理，从而在保持或提高任务成功率的同时显著降低Token消耗。
AI.motivation: 智能体框架在接收到工具反馈后会重复调用推理，即使先前的调用已经确定了下一个操作，导致了不必要的Token浪费。
AI.method: 提出HarnessMM方法，利用可执行决策图存储精确操作和依赖关系。在模型-工具边界部署控制器，通过受保护的决策重用和经过认证的回调替换，用已解析的决策替代后续的推理回调。该方法通过递归自我改进优化框架配置，并在遇到新语义决策时回退至原始模型。
AI.result: 在HumanEval上，Codex成功率保持90.82%，每任务Token数减少29.54%（从66.72k降至47.02k）。对于DeepSeek框架，成功率从71.43%提升至85.71%，Token数大幅减少87.93%（从96.28k降至11.62k）。MBPP消融实验显示其成本显著低于单次使用图和保留回调方法。
AI.conclusion: 受保护的决策重用是减少现有智能体框架中重复推理、提升Token效率的实用有效途径。

title: Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
summary: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student's learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering. In one ALFWorld timing setting, the additional collection cost is offset by a shorter time to a target success rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Frontier-OPD方法，通过识别学生的学习前沿（即具有挑战性但可在简短教师指导下自主延续的决策情境），来改进多轮智能体的在策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有的在策略蒸馏方法在为多轮智能体获取有效监督时，难以确定何时需要指导以及学生是否能在指导后维持交互。
AI.method: Frontier-OPD将在策略经验组织成共享状态轨迹图，利用轨迹平衡的教师-学生分歧聚合来识别干预候选，并评估简短的教师桥梁是否能被当前学生利用；通过的教师响应将增强普通蒸馏数据。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上的实验表明，该方法比蒸馏基线具有更高的平均自主性能，消融实验表明候选选择和指导过滤具有互补效应。
AI.conclusion: 聚焦于学生的学习前沿能够有效过滤和选择教师指导，从而提升多轮智能体蒸馏的性能与效率。

title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合调整扩散努力程度和推测解码接受宽松度，探索并扩展了基于扩散模型的推测解码的速度与质量帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码无损但速度有限，而扩散大语言模型通过降低质量换取并行生成加速。本文旨在解决如何平衡扩散采样的速度与质量，并探索通过放宽接受标准实现有损但更快的推测解码的潜力。
AI.method: 提出联合改变两个关键参数的方法：扩散模型的扩散努力程度和推测解码中验证器分布的接受宽松度，从而探索完整的可实现帕累托前沿。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，联合调整扩散努力程度和接受宽松度，相比单步扩散草稿生成，能够显著扩展速度与质量的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 结合扩散模型的并行采样特性与宽松的推测解码接受标准，能够在速度与质量的权衡中取得更优的性能表现，为扩散模型草稿生成提供了新的优化路径。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将连续空间攻击框架直接与连续扩散语言模型（dLLM）结合，以生成更自然的对抗性提示词，从而更准确地评估黑盒大语言模型的风险。
AI.motivation: 现有的连续空间攻击使用人工随机映射解码潜空间，导致生成的提示词不自然、易被输入防护栏检测，且模型风险评估缺乏自然提示词的支撑。
AI.method: 将标准的连续高斯潜空间框架直接与学习到的语言生成分布（连续扩散语言模型，dLLM）耦合，去除人工随机映射，同时保留原有的采样或优化过程。
AI.result: 在基于采样的RareTrap和基于优化的ThinkTrap两种设置下，字符级困惑度显著下降（RareTrap中从10^3-10^7降至3-5，ThinkTrap中从20-28降至4.3-5.4）；且两种映射方法下的模型风险评估结果相差可达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过与连续扩散语言模型结合，可以生成更自然、难以被防护栏检测的对抗性提示词，从而提供更接地的模型风险评估，揭示了提示词的自然度对风险估计的重要影响。

title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of RMT-Jailbreak, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RMT-Jailbreak框架，通过将自回归模型生成的有害响应转化为高掩码比例模板，成功将AR式越狱攻击迁移到扩散式大语言模型(dLLMs)上。
AI.motivation: 扩散式大语言模型通过双向上下文建模实现灵活的掩码生成，但这引入了独特的越狱攻击面。作者发现有害响应可作为有效的越狱模板，仅需掩码其部分token即可诱导dLLM重构有害内容。
AI.method: RMT-Jailbreak框架将AR模型生成的有害响应通过均匀token保留转化为高掩码比例模板，再应用基于提示的安全过滤掩码剩余可见的有害内容，最后将精炼模板提供给目标dLLM进行双向重构。
AI.result: 在多种AR越狱方法和目标dLLMs上的广泛实验证明了RMT-Jailbreak的有效性和通用性，揭示了越狱攻击在跨范式间的强可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了dLLMs存在通过掩码模板进行越狱攻击的安全风险，且AR越狱攻击具有跨范式迁移到dLLMs的能力，这对dLLMs的安全防护提出了新的挑战。

title: Trion-1: Unifying Language, Protein Sequence, and Structure with Diffusion Language Models
summary: We envision a general-purpose protein foundation model as a unified, interactive model of sequence, structure, and function, capable of understanding, generation, and cross-modal translation while retaining the instruction-following and reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs. Toward this vision, we introduce Trion-1, the first native, unified, multimodal diffusion language model (dLLM) for proteins. Trion-1 is built on two key design choices: (1) a unified discrete token space that jointly represents sequence, structure, and natural language; (2) a dLLM backbone that replaces strict left-to-right factorization with bidirectional or semi-bidirectional token interactions, enabling global residue communication and long-range contact modeling that are naturally suited to structure modeling. This formulation unifies six core capabilities: folding, inverse folding, sequence understanding, structure understanding, sequence design, and structure design, while retaining the native language capabilities of general-purpose LLMs. On established benchmarks, Trion-1 achieves broadly competitive performance. In folding, Trion-1 achieves a TM-score above 0.8 with a single sample under strict homology control, matching or exceeding the existing tri-modal model using 200 samples. For sequence understanding, Trion-1 performs on par with top-tier LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.7 (62.37%). These results support well-aligned sequence-structure-language representations and strong cross-modal generative capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个统一的蛋白质多模态扩散语言模型Trion-1，能够在单一框架内实现蛋白质序列、结构和功能的理解、生成与跨模态转换。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个通用的蛋白质基础模型，使其能同时处理蛋白质的序列、结构与功能，并保留现代大型语言模型（LLM）的指令遵循与推理能力。
AI.method: 采用统一的离散标记空间联合表示蛋白质序列、结构和自然语言；并使用扩散语言模型（dLLM）骨干网络替代严格的从左到右的因式分解，实现双向或半双向的标记交互，从而支持全局残基通信和长程接触建模。
AI.result: 在折叠任务中，严格同源控制下单样本TM-score超过0.8，超越了使用200个样本的现有三模态模型；在序列理解任务中，表现与顶级LLM（如Claude Opus 4.7，62.37%）相当。
AI.conclusion: Trion-1成功统一了蛋白质折叠、逆折叠、序列/结构理解与设计等六大核心能力，实验结果证明了其序列-结构-语言表示的良好对齐以及强大的跨模态生成能力。

title: GRAFT: Restoring the Missing Sampling Interface in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate a whole sequence in parallel, never drawing a single word at any intermediate step; only the final step turns embeddings into text. Models such as ELF now report autoregressive-level quality at a fraction of the sampling steps of discrete-token diffusion models, and this design principle -- no step-wise discretization -- is what their own ablations credit for the gain. We show that this same principle carries a hidden cost: a collapse of the lexical long tail. Measured against held-out human text, ELF's output matches the human rate on common words almost exactly, yet its rarest words appear at only 0.30x the human rate, a gap that does not close from 105M to 652M parameters and that no sampler setting these models expose can reach. A same-size GPT-2, in contrast, spans zero to above the human rate by its decoding rule alone. We trace the difference to what continuous diffusion models lack: with no step that ever draws a discrete word, every step is instead driven by an average over the candidates still in play, and averaging a rare candidate together with the common word competing for its slot lands on the common word. An autoregressive model avoids this because its decoding rule samples one candidate rather than averaging over all of them. We propose GRAFT, a training-free method that grafts this missing choice back onto a frozen model: while the model is still undecided, GRAFT commits the rare words the average would otherwise discard, then regenerates the sequence from scratch with those commitments held in place. Across three ELF scales and on LangFlow, an independent continuous dLLM, GRAFT restores the rare-word share of generated text from 0.42-0.77x the human rate to 0.82-1.10x, a relative gain of 34-109%, and moves the entire word-frequency profile closer to human on every model tested, by 2.7x on ELF-B and 12x on LangFlow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需训练的GRAFT方法，通过强制提交被平均化丢弃的罕见词，解决连续扩散语言模型中罕见词生成率过低的问题。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型因缺乏逐步离散化步骤，导致罕见词生成率远低于人类水平，且无法通过扩大模型规模或调整采样器参数来解决。
AI.method: 提出一种名为GRAFT的无训练方法。该方法在冻结模型未决阶段，强制提交被平均化丢弃的罕见词，并以此约束从零重新生成序列。
AI.result: 在三个ELF规模和独立模型LangFlow上的实验表明，GRAFT将罕见词占比从人类水平的0.42-0.77倍提升至0.82-1.10倍（相对提升34-109%），并使整体词频分布更接近人类文本（ELF-B提升2.7倍，LangFlow提升12倍）。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散模型缺乏离散采样选择导致长尾词汇缺失，而GRAFT方法有效弥补了这一缺陷，显著改善了生成文本的词汇分布。

title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
summary: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffResearch，一个以扩散语言模型为核心的开放多智能体深度研究框架，相比传统自回归模型显著降低了端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 基于自回归语言模型的深度研究系统因从左到右的解码方式导致端到端延迟较高，成为交互式应用的主要瓶颈。本文旨在解决此延迟问题并评估扩散模型骨干的效果。
AI.method: 提出DiffResearch框架，在每个阶段核心使用扩散语言模型（dLLM）；并引入dFast分解模式，通过读取中间去噪状态在生成完成前提取子查询。
AI.result: 在100个Deep Research Bench任务中，扩散骨干端到端速度快约6倍；dFast分解模式实现1.99倍中位数加速且不损失报告质量；dFast在RACE评分中获最高总分；基于更强扩散模型的实例在公开排行榜超越多个商业系统。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型在深度研究系统中能大幅降低延迟并保持高质量，展示了其在构建高效多智能体系统方面的巨大潜力。该系统已基于Apache-2.0开源。

title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的解码器TeCoP，通过解耦预测的提交准备度与上下文效用，显著提升了扩散大语言模型的生成效率和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型的块级解码器存在序列化生成和重复计算稳定预测的低效问题，根本原因在于预测的不可逆提交准备度与其作为上下文的效用之间发生了耦合。
AI.method: 提出Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP) 解码器，采用交错的块并行流水线和草稿验证机制，将稳定但未提交的预测作为临时跨块上下文重用，并通过置信度和稳定性检查来控制预测的最终提交。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，TeCoP将前向评估次数减少高达87%，无KV缓存时吞吐量提升达7.50倍，有缓存时达11.77倍，在所有设置下均优于Fast-dLLM和DSB，且平均准确率与原解码器相差不到1%。
AI.conclusion: TeCoP有效解决了dLLMs解码过程中的低效耦合问题，在不牺牲准确率的前提下实现了大幅的吞吐量提升，为dLLMs的高效推理提供了重要方法。

title: Who Gets Unmasked? Sampler-Induced Bias in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate by gradually unmasking a canvas, so their samplers decide not only which token to write but also when to commit it. We show that this second decision changes who appears in generated text, a sampler-induced bias on top of the model's own. Common commit rules, including LLaDA's default, commit the positions whose sampled tokens are most probable; this peeking favors majority options. To separate the sampler from the model, we read the model's belief about a fork, such as a protagonist's gender, in one forward pass, and show that this belief matches exact sampling from the model. Measured against it, peeking samplers on LLaDA and Dream amplify occupational gender stereotypes and collapse opinion distributions, and confidence-based ordering shifts gender-balanced occupations toward men, more so under faster parallel decoding. We propose Fork-First Sampling, which decides the fork before anything else is written: it follows the belief or any target distribution, improves fluency, and avoids the stories that remark on the protagonist's gender, which prompt-based fixes produce, at the cost of one forward pass. Fairness evaluations of dLLMs should report the commit rule.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散语言模型采样器在提交token时引入的偏见，并提出了Fork-First Sampling以消除该偏见。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的采样器不仅决定写入的token，还决定何时提交，这种提交规则会在模型自身偏见之上引入额外的偏见（如偏向多数选项），从而放大刻板印象。
AI.method: 提出Fork-First Sampling，在生成任何其他内容之前，先根据模型信念或目标分布决定“分叉”（如主角性别），仅需一次额外的前向传播。
AI.result: 实验表明，常见的“偷看”采样器会放大LLaDA和Dream的职业性别刻板印象并导致意见分布坍塌；而Fork-First Sampling能提升流畅性，避免基于提示修复导致的性别相关描述，且仅增加一次前向传播的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 对扩散语言模型的公平性评估应报告其提交规则，因为采样策略会显著影响生成结果的偏见。

title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PV-Decoding，一种具有渐进式验证的置信度驱动投机解码框架，有效提升了离散扩散语言模型的推理效率和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的推理效率受限于安全提交预测的成本，而现有的投机解码方法因同一扩散块内token的相互依赖性，容易导致错误传播或面临高昂的验证计算成本。
AI.method: PV-Decoding利用双置信度阈值将掩码位置分为直接解码token、投机token和未解决token，并采用从单批次到多批次的渐进式策略验证投机token，以在精度与效率之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MBPP和HumanEval数据集上的实验表明，PV-Decoding相比基于置信度的解码减少了8%-37%的顺序模型前向传递，且最大精度下降仅为1.3%。在Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K上，单批次和双批次策略将吞吐量提升了7.0%-13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结合置信度引导与结构化验证的投机解码是实现高效且可靠的离散扩散语言模型推理的实用途径。

title: DiffuPlan: Editable Planning State for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, yet dLLM agents largely inherit an interaction protocol designed for AR generation: once intermediate state is written, later observations can only be incorporated by appending more text. This is a poor match to a defining capability of dLLMs -- reconstructing earlier text conditioned on context that appears both before and after it. We ask whether this capability can support a different agent-state paradigm in which intermediate planning state is directly revisable as evidence arrives. We introduce DiffuPlan, a diffusion search agent that maintains a single editable planning state and reconstructs only the affected steps when later evidence resolves an entity or changes the search route. To support variable-length revisions, we introduce Expansion-Partition Marginalization (EPM), which marginalizes over equivalent expansion paths. We further adapt diffusion trajectory RL to multi-turn search. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, DiffuPlan achieves 50.24 average F1, outperforming strong AR search agents. More importantly, under identical data and training, editable planning state improves the diffusion agent by 2.44 F1 versus only 0.47 for its AR source model. These results show that dLLMs need not imitate append-only AR agents: revising committed state is a distinct agentic advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffuPlan，一种利用扩散模型保持可编辑规划状态并动态重构受影响步骤的搜索智能体，证明了可修正已定状态是扩散模型智能体的独特优势。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型（dLLM）智能体沿用了自回归（AR）模型仅追加文本的交互协议，未能发挥dLLM能够基于前后上下文重构先前文本的核心能力。本文旨在解决这一不匹配问题，探索dLLM是否支持一种可直接修正中间规划状态的新范式。
AI.method: 提出了DiffuPlan，一种维持单一可编辑规划状态并在新证据出现时仅重构受影响步骤的扩散搜索智能体。引入了Expansion-Partition Marginalization（EPM）以支持变长修订，并将扩散轨迹强化学习适配到多轮搜索中。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准测试中，DiffuPlan取得了50.24的平均F1分数，优于强大的AR搜索智能体。在相同数据和训练下，可编辑规划状态使扩散智能体的F1提升了2.44，而其AR源模型仅提升0.47。
AI.conclusion: 扩散语言模型无需模仿仅追加的自回归智能体；根据后续证据直接修正已提交的规划状态是dLLM智能体的一项独特优势。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练，以分别优化基于树的推测解码中的验证延迟和接受率。
AI.motivation: 基于树的推测解码在有限树结构上存在草稿模型与目标模型不匹配的根本问题，且现有验证方法可能存在延迟瓶颈，需要探索如何在不改变固定树结构的情况下提升接受率，以及如何利用目标模型反馈改进树结构。
AI.method: 通过目标流视角识别出规范的退出定律，证明其能严格界定任何精确路径验证器的预期输出块长度，据此提出精确且层级并行的TEV验证程序；同时利用退出定律识别缺失的目标概率，提供节点级反馈用于ExitTrain训练推理时的草稿树。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验表明，ExitTrain将平均输出块长度增加了13%，而TEV将验证器阶段延迟降低了15%，与DDTree相比实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了两个优化方向：构建更优的草稿树以获得更高的接受率，以及采用更直接的验证方法以降低延迟。所提方法在多种任务上均验证了有效性和实用性。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DominoTree，一种结合路径依赖条件化和因果校正的无训练树状推测解码方法，显著提升了大语言模型的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的树状推测解码方法（如DDTree）在评分时忽略了分支早期词元，而条件化方法（如Domino）只能生成单条链；本文旨在解决这两种方法的局限性以进一步加速大模型推理。
AI.method: DominoTree构建了一个无需训练的best-first树，利用Domino的路径依赖因果校正进行评分，并将候选限制为top-M，从而结合了树状结构的广度与路径依赖条件化的精确性。
AI.result: 在零温度研究环境中，相比自回归解码平均实现5.33倍（Qwen3-4B）和6.89倍（Qwen3-8B）加速；在不同温度下比Domino快20-36%，比DDTree/CaDDTree快11-20%。在SGLang部署中（batch size 1），达到4.11倍和4.83倍加速，且在所有服务设置下接受的词元数均多于链式方法。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree在低并发（如batch size 1-2）下显著优于链式方法，但在高并发（8个以上）时链式方法能维持更高吞吐量。此外，在混合架构（如Gated-DeltaNet）上需采用树感知循环验证以保证正确输出，此时该方法在长上下文下表现优异。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配，优化基于扩散语言模型的推测解码中的草稿树构建。
AI.motivation: 现有的树构建方法与扩散语言模型（DLM）草稿器不兼容，且现有的DDTree方法仅依赖概率选择边缘而忽略父子兼容性，同时固定预算无法适应吞吐量最优的树大小变化。
AI.method: GRAFT引入了目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES），从目标模型轨迹中提取父子偏好以选择目标兼容的边缘；以及状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡预期草稿增益和验证成本来设定每轮树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮额外开销不到0.5毫秒，约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT有效弥合了DLM草稿器在树状推测解码中的差距，实现了显著的加速效果且额外开销极低。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CaDDTree，一种成本感知的扩散草稿树方法，通过联合选择树结构和节点预算来直接优化令牌吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的DDTree方法在固定节点预算下最大化预期接受长度，由于接受长度随预算单调递增，导致其缺乏选择预算的原则性基础且忽略了验证成本。
AI.method: CaDDTree显式建模草稿和验证延迟，将吞吐量目标分解为每轮预算的一维搜索，并证明了在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而实现高效的贪心停止规则，且无需离线预算搜索。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上的八项基准测试表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上都能匹配或超越具有oracle预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree提供了一种原则性的成本感知方法，能够动态适应每轮的分布和验证成本，有效提升了推理吞吐量。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS，一种目标感知前缀选择方法，通过将扩散边缘概率转化为路径条件接受估计，解决了扩散模型并行起草在投机解码中的验证瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散树的投机解码方法使用边际概率对节点进行排序，忽略了验证是前缀条件化的，导致会验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代，增加了延迟且接受度提升有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS方法，将扩散边际概率转换为路径条件接受估计，并在固定的验证预算下选择一个紧凑的前缀闭合子树，从而改善接受-成本权衡。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和模型家族上的实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，分别比最先进的DFlash和DDTree高出1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过优化接受-成本权衡而非简单地扩展草稿树，有效解决了扩散模型投机解码中的验证瓶颈问题，并取得了显著的加速效果。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DDTree（Diffusion Draft Tree），通过从块扩散模型的位置分布构建草稿树来提升推测解码的性能和接受长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的DFlash模型虽能高效生成草稿块，但每轮仅验证单条草稿轨迹，限制了其接受长度。
AI.method: DDTree直接从块扩散起草器的位置分布构建草稿树，使用最佳优先堆算法在固定节点预算下选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续，并利用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中高效验证该树。
AI.result: 基于DFlash的DDTree获得了显著性能提升，使其成为推测解码领域的领先方法之一。
AI.conclusion: DDTree通过构建并高效验证草稿树，成功克服了单轨迹验证的局限性，确立了其在推测解码中的领先地位。

title: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks. Moreover, existing compression methods often overlook the explosive accumulation of approximation errors. To address this issue, we propose Video-MemComp, a training-free and sensitivity-aware context management framework for memory-constrained streaming video understanding. Our method theoretically decomposes compression error into orthogonal local approximation error and layer-wise structural sensitivity via a first-order Taylor expansion. To minimize local approximation error, we perform token aggregation in a pre-RoPE safe zone with an attention-conserving logit bias, mitigating geometric distortions caused by RoPE rotations. To manage layer-wise structural sensitivity, we dynamically allocate the KV cache budget based on offline gradient priors and online context entropy, prioritizing high-sensitivity layers. Video-MemComp outperforms or achieves performance comparable to full-cache and state-of-the-art compression methods on benchmarks including MLVU, VideoMME, and EgoSchema. Notably, it improves the overall accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B from 62.3% to 64.1% while reducing the KV cache to an equivalent of 6,000 tokens per layer, saving over 90% of KV memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Video-MemComp，一个无训练且感知敏感度的上下文管理框架，用于解决多模态大语言模型在流式视频理解中的内存瓶颈和压缩误差累积问题。
AI.motivation: 随着视频数据的快速增长，多模态大语言模型在处理长视频时面临严重的内存瓶颈，且现有的压缩方法往往忽略了近似误差的爆炸性累积。
AI.method: 该方法通过一阶泰勒展开将压缩误差分解为正交局部近似误差和层级结构敏感度；通过在pre-RoPE安全区进行带有注意力保留logit偏差的token聚合来最小化局部近似误差；并根据离线梯度先验和在线上下文熵动态分配KV缓存预算，以优先处理高敏感度层。
AI.result: 在MLVU、VideoMME和EgoSchema等基准测试上，该方法优于或达到与全缓存和最先进压缩方法相当的性能。值得注意的是，它将Qwen2.5-VL-3B的整体准确率从62.3%提高到64.1%，同时将每层KV缓存减少到相当于6,000个token，节省了超过90%的KV内存。
AI.conclusion: Video-MemComp能够在无需训练的情况下，通过理论分解和管理压缩误差，有效实现内存受限的流式视频理解，同时大幅节省内存并提升模型性能。

title: The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible. Zooming in recovers the evidence, but the region must be chosen before the model answers. We find that MLLMs know where the evidence is, but not in a form that can be read before they answer: the answer tokens localize it from the middle layers on, whereas the attention available before answering does so only in the top layers, at a depth that varies across models, and diffusely. Supervising the pre-answer attention to point degrades reading, and the benefit of zooming is governed by each image's information gap. Building on these findings, we introduce ours, which lets an MLLM look where its answer would. A dedicated look token, processed in a single prefill and kept out of the answering pass, learns in hindsight to attend as the model's own correct answers do, extracting this knowledge into a concentrated pointer before any answer exists. Its hidden state then selects how to look, from no zoom to crops, square windows, windows that adapt to the pointer and foveated warps, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view. ours needs no box annotations, per-model layer search, external localizers or generation before the answer. On Qwen3-VL at three scales and five text-rich benchmarks, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 4.8-9.1 points at 98 visual tokens per view and attention-guided zooming by 11.1-17.0 points, while running faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用专用“look token”在模型回答前回顾性定位图像证据的方法，有效解决了低视觉令牌预算下多模态大模型文本识别困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 在低视觉令牌预算下，MLLM难以辨认文档和图表中的细粒度文本。虽然放大图像有助于恢复证据，但模型在回答前无法准确选择需要放大的区域。
AI.method: 引入一个在单次预填充中处理的专用“look token”，它通过事后学习像模型正确答案那样集中注意力，在回答前提取出指向证据的指针。该指针的隐藏状态指导模型如何查看（如裁剪、自适应窗口等），并由反事实结果监督，无需边界框标注或外部定位器。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL的三个规模和五个文本丰富的基准测试上，该方法在98个视觉令牌预算下比最强基线高4.8-9.1分，比注意力引导缩放高11.1-17.0分，且运行速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将模型对证据位置的隐式知识转化为回答前可用的集中指针，在无需额外标注或外部工具的情况下，显著提升了低预算下文本密集型图像的解析能力。

title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对多模态情感识别的智能体技能框架CASE，通过维护可进化的成对情感技能库来解决语义相邻情感间的混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在语义相邻且多模态线索高度重叠的情感间存在系统性混淆，而现有的全局参数适配方法成本高昂且缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 提出了一种混淆感知技能进化框架（CASE），该框架维护一个稀疏且自我进化的成对情感技能（EmotionSkills）库，在推理时动态检索合适的EmotionSkill以增强边界感知推理，同时保持MLLM主干冻结。
AI.result: 在CA-MER、DFEW和EMER数据集上的实验证明了CASE的有效性和跨模型的可迁移性，将Qwen3-VL-8B在CA-MER基准上的平均准确率从46.80%提升至59.13%。
AI.conclusion: CASE通过将情感专业知识外部化为可复用、可转移的技能，成功解决了局部情感混淆问题，为在保持基础模型冻结的情况下提升情感识别能力提供了新方向。

title: Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. The prior conditions only on the input, whereas the posterior uses additional training-time relational evidence to guide reasoning exploration. To translate the posterior's broader exploration into inference-time improvements, we derive an importance-weighted variational objective and instantiate it as a prior-posterior co-evolution framework that improves both modes under a shared inference-compatible reward while selectively transferring posterior trajectories to the prior according to their utility and prior reachability. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, PILOT outperforms the primary baseline across all 12 task groups at both 2B and 7B parameters, improving overall scores by 3.2 and 3.3 points, respectively, with the largest gains in visual-document retrieval (+6.1 and +6.4 points). Our results show that relational supervision is most valuable not as a post-hoc reward but as a signal for shaping how reasoning is explored in training reasoning-enhanced embedding models.

AI.tldr: 提出PILOT框架，将推理建模为潜在变量，通过先验和后验分布的协同进化来优化多模态嵌入模型的推理探索。
AI.motivation: 现有检索监督方法未明确指导输入增强所用的推理，且仅基于输入优化推理，限制了对检索相关推理轨迹的探索。
AI.method: 引入PILOT框架，将推理作为潜在变量，利用共享MLLM的先验（仅基于输入）和后验（使用关系证据）分布，通过重要性加权变分目标实现先验-后验协同进化，并根据效用和先验可达性选择性地将后验轨迹转移给先验。
AI.result: 在MMEB-V2基准上，PILOT在2B和7B参数下的所有12个任务组中均优于基线，总分分别提高3.2和3.3分，视觉文档检索提升最为显著（+6.1和+6.4分）。
AI.conclusion: 关系监督最有效的应用方式不是作为事后奖励，而是作为塑造推理增强嵌入模型训练中推理探索方式的信号。

title: Adaptive Control of Scientific Instruments with Nonstationary Responses through Multimodal Agents
summary: Controlling scientific instruments requires parameters to be adjusted progressively in response to feedback from successive operations. When unobserved operating conditions evolve with operational history, responses become nonstationary, and a static mapping from actions to responses becomes inadequate for decisions across shots. Shot-to-shot tuning of neutral beam injection (NBI) ion sources in magnetic confinement fusion devices is representative of this class of problems: the conditions of electrode surfaces and vacuum are difficult to observe directly, discharge outcomes vary between shots, and experiments are costly and carry operational risks. We propose a physically grounded multimodal agent with three independently auditable components. Deterministic algorithms extract symbolic physical quantities and visual evidence from multichannel waveforms; a memory with two layers organizes trajectories from the current task, experience from earlier tasks, and procedural knowledge, from which a multimodal large language model (MLLM) generates candidate actions; and an independent action feasibility check enforces action constraints before execution. In a strictly chronological replay of 455 shots from four EXL-50U platforms, physical symbols alone outperformed waveform images alone by 0.21-0.32 in macro-F1 for quality classification across all four evaluated models. Retrieved context increased the mean agreement with historical action directions by 22.4-42.7 percentage points, whereas the contribution of visual evidence varied across models. Under supervised operation on five ion sources, the system achieved a beam-extraction rate of 86.80% across 409 executed shots. These results demonstrate the engineering feasibility of the framework for supervised sequential tuning on a physical scientific instrument.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理的多模态智能体框架，用于在非平稳条件下对科学仪器进行监督式序列调参。
AI.motivation: 科学仪器的不可观测运行条件随操作历史演变会导致响应非平稳，传统的静态映射方法失效。以磁约束聚变装置中的中性束注入离子源调参为代表，此类实验成本高且伴随风险，亟需新的决策方法。
AI.method: 提出包含三个独立可审计组件的物理多模态智能体：1）确定性算法从多通道波形提取符号物理量和视觉证据；2）双层记忆组织当前轨迹、历史经验与过程知识，由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成候选动作；3）独立动作可行性检查在执行前施加约束。
AI.result: 在EXL-50U平台的455次历史重放中，仅用物理符号比仅用波形图像在质量分类上的宏平均F1值高0.21-0.32；检索上下文使与历史动作方向的一致性提升22.4-42.7个百分点。在5个离子源的监督运行中，409次执行放电实现了86.80%的束流引出率。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了该框架在物理科学仪器上进行监督式序列调参的工程可行性。

title: Beyond Pattern Matching in 3D MLLMs: Part-Level Functional Reasoning for Generalizable Recognition
summary: 3D MLLMs recognize objects via pattern matching, which fails when geometrically similar objects require functional reasoning to disambiguate (e.g., dresser vs. wardrobe). Our per-sample Geometric Confusion Score (GCS) exposes this failure: baseline accuracy is 33.7% on ModelNet40's most ambiguous 20% versus 84.0% on its least ambiguous 20%. We identify a function-as-annotation pattern, in which functional language decorates a known identity instead of supporting inference, and hypothesize that reversing this information flow should concentrate improvements on the most ambiguous samples. PFIR (Part-level Functional Inference for Recognition) reverses that flow. Built on PartNeXt part segmentation, its data pipeline produces 507K QA pairs with functional CoTs (geometry $\to$ function $\to$ identity), and its progressive curriculum culminates in dual-objective GRPO: strict functional reasoning and descriptive grounding for Objaverse's diverse distribution. The two RL objectives yield nearly orthogonal task vectors ($\cos = 0.056$), enabling composition via Task Arithmetic. Under a strict dual OOD protocol (Objaverse $\to$ ModelNet40; XYZRGB $\to$ XYZ-only), PFIR raises zero-shot accuracy from 60.5% to 66.7%, with gains concentrated $2.6\times$ more on geometrically ambiguous samples---supporting part-level functional reasoning as an effective route to more generalizable 3D recognition. Code: https://github.com/this233/pfir-3d.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PFIR方法，通过部件级功能推理反转信息流，有效解决了3D多模态大模型在几何相似物体上的识别消歧问题。
AI.motivation: 现有3D MLLMs依赖模式匹配，在需功能推理消歧的几何相似物体上识别失败，且存在功能即注释模式导致功能语言未支持推理。
AI.method: 提出PFIR框架，基于PartNeXt部件分割构建含功能思维链（几何到功能再到身份）的50万条问答对；采用渐进式课程与双目标GRPO强化学习，并结合任务算术组合近正交任务向量。
AI.result: 在双重OOD测试中，零样本准确率从60.5%提升至66.7%，且在几何模糊样本上的提升增益高出2.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 部件级功能推理是提升3D识别泛化能力的有效途径，反转信息流能针对性地改善几何模糊样本的识别。

title: Label-Budgeted Attribute Inference from Protected Features in Edge-Cloud Split Multimodal LLMs
summary: Edge-cloud split inference runs the early layers of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) on a device and sends intermediate features to a server to complete the task. While keeping raw images local is often perceived as a privacy benefit, an honest-but-curious server can still infer sensitive attributes, such as age, gender, and race, from the received features. Existing protections intervene at the input, transmitted representation, or model's responses, but their native evaluations rely on final-response refusals or fixed-classifier failures, which underestimate an adaptive server's capabilities. To address this, we propose a label-budgeted attribute-inference framework that measures representation-level privacy through a recovery curve: the share of the unprotected leakage the server recovers as a function of its labeled-sample budget, from zero (a classifier trained on unprotected features) to a full labeled set. Our evaluation across two popular MLLMs reveals two critical findings. First, in unprotected pipelines, intermediate features leak all three attributes regardless of the split depth. Second, even when protection mechanisms are deployed across different stages, sensitive information remains recoverable under limited label budgets. For example, Safe-LLaVA removes biometric content from the model's responses, but from the features it transmits in split inference, 20 labeled samples per class recover 75-85% of the unprotected leakage. This work provides a label-budgeted measure of feature-level privacy for split MLLM inference and motivates defenses that act on the transmitted representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种标签预算属性推理框架，用于衡量多模态大语言模型（MLLM）边缘-云端拆分推理中的特征级隐私泄漏程度。
AI.motivation: 边缘-云端拆分推理的中间特征会向诚实但好奇的服务器泄漏敏感属性，而现有保护机制因依赖最终响应拒绝或固定分类器失效，低估了自适应服务器的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出一种标签预算属性推理框架，通过“恢复曲线”（即服务器在不同标签样本预算下恢复未受保护泄漏的比例）来评估表征级隐私。
AI.result: 评估发现：未受保护的中间特征无论拆分深度如何均会泄漏属性；即使部署了保护机制，敏感信息在有限标签预算下仍可被恢复（例如Safe-LLaVA仅需每类20个标记样本即可恢复75-85%的未受保护泄漏）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为拆分MLLM推理提供了特征级隐私的标签预算度量，并表明亟需开发直接作用于传输表征的防御机制。

title: DriveMind: Mind-Evolving Belief Tracking for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perceive a traffic scene, reason about it, and propose a driving action within a single model. However, existing MLLM-based drivers reason from scratch at each frame and commit to a single explanation, discarding earlier hypotheses about the scene. When the scene is ambiguous, the agent locks in on the wrong interpretation and acts on it before evidence accumulates. In this paper, we propose DriveMind, an MLLM-based driving framework that keeps several hypotheses about the scene alive at the same time and updates their weights as new frames arrive. Inspired by particle filtering, DriveMind propagates each hypothesis through a VLM, scores it against the current observation, and resamples to maintain diversity. On Bench2Drive, adding belief tracking to the same driving pipeline improves the Driving Score (DS) from 68.50 to 81.37 and the Success Rate (SR) from 41.36% to 54.09%. The largest gains occur on ambiguous scenarios such as unsignalized intersections (+20.0 DS) and oncoming-traffic interactions (+20.5 DS). Beyond the overall metrics, DriveMind also improves fine-grained interactive driving abilities such as merging, emergency braking, and give-way.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DriveMind框架，通过受粒子滤波启发的信念追踪机制同时维护多个场景假设，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在模糊场景下的自动驾驶能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的自动驾驶系统在每一帧都从零开始推理并局限于单一解释，导致在场景模糊时会在证据积累前锁定错误解释并据此行动。
AI.method: 提出DriveMind框架，受粒子滤波启发，同时保持关于场景的多个假设，并在新帧到达时更新其权重；通过视觉语言模型（VLM）传播每个假设，根据当前观测对其进行评分，并重采样以保持多样性。
AI.result: 在Bench2Drive基准上，驾驶分数（DS）从68.50提升至81.37，成功率（SR）从41.36%提升至54.09%。在无信号交叉口和对向来车交互等模糊场景中提升最大，同时改善了汇入、紧急制动和让行等细粒度交互驾驶能力。
AI.conclusion: 将信念追踪机制集成到基于MLLM的驾驶流程中，能有效处理场景模糊性，从而大幅提升整体驾驶指标及细粒度交互驾驶能力。

title: KiRoSe: Using Kinematic Data for Efficient Segmentation of Robot Demonstrations
summary: Segmenting robot demonstration data into disjoint temporal and semantic subsegments is valuable for learning, cleaning, retrieval, and analysis. Segmentation is often performed manually in a tedious and error prone process. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have the potential for automating this process, but directly ingesting raw multi camera video streams into MLLMs can be costly and can quickly exhaust context windows. In this paper, we introduce KiRoSe (Kinematics for Robot Segmentation), a novel framework that focuses on the companion stream of robot kinematic data. Inspired by the principle of classical entropy coding, such as Huffman coding, where frequently occurring symbols are represented more compactly, we propose Sparse Motion Tokens (SMTs), a discrete kinematic vocabulary designed to compactly represent recurring, temporally localized motion patterns, which we refer to as kinematic events. SMTs are learned by encoding kinematic trajectories with temporal segment supervision and quantizing the resulting features. We use increasingly available robot demonstration subtask annotations to supervise an open language model to interpret the resulting token sequences. Evaluation against human labeled segmentation shows that KiRoSe can substantially outperform baseline segmentation methods in F1 quality and transfers zero shot to unseen robot embodiments and egocentric human motion, while preserving the language models open vocabulary knowledge. Beyond segmentation, KiRoSe tracks task progress on an unseen robot and detects when an action is being reversed.(website: https://berkeleyautomation.github.io/kirose/)

AI.tldr: 本文提出KiRoSe框架，通过将机器人运动学数据转换为稀疏运动标记(SMTs)，利用大语言模型高效自动地实现机器人演示数据分割。
AI.motivation: 机器人演示数据的人工分割过程繁琐且易出错，而直接将原始多相机视频流输入多模态大语言模型成本高昂且易耗尽上下文窗口。
AI.method: KiRoSe聚焦于机器人运动学数据流，提出稀疏运动标记(SMTs)，这是一种受熵编码启发的离散运动学词汇表。它通过在时序片段监督下编码运动学轨迹并量化特征来学习，以紧凑表示局部运动模式，随后利用子任务注释监督开放语言模型解释生成的标记序列。
AI.result: KiRoSe在F1分割质量上显著优于基线方法，且能零样本迁移至未见过的机器人形态和以自我为中心的人类运动，同时保留语言模型的开放词汇知识；此外，它还能在未见机器人上跟踪任务进度并检测动作反转。
AI.conclusion: KiRoSe提供了一种高效、自动且具泛化能力的机器人数据分割方案，通过结合紧凑的运动学标记与语言模型，成功将应用扩展至任务进度跟踪和动作反转检测。

title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
summary: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures (including supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/PhysTrace/PhysTrace

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个无需训练的框架PhysTrace，通过将多模态大语言模型生成的物理预期与观测视频对齐，以时间定位并解释物理违规现象。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型依赖预训练视频模型来捕捉物理动态，但现有评估方法很少能识别出哪些基于历史条件的物理预期与实际观测结果存在冲突。
AI.method: 提出PhysTrace框架，无需任务特定的探针或分类器，将MLLM生成的历史条件预期与观测视频窗口对齐，从而时间定位物理违规并提供可解释描述；同时引入了添加违规区间的IntPhys2-Timing数据集。
AI.result: PhysTrace在IntPhys2-Timing上的命中率高达70.7%，并在IntPhys2上的总体可能-不可能判别准确率上优于对比方法；应用于预训练视频模型轨迹的重建视频时，揭示了物理违规定位依赖于属性和噪声的模式。
AI.conclusion: PhysTrace能够跨时间步实现可解释的物理一致性分析，为评估和改进基于预训练视频模型的世界动作模型提供了有效工具。
